title: QuickFilters dual-format adapter: Spec ↔ ObjectUI type union + bridge normalization
body:
Spec uses `{ field, operator, value }` for quick filters; ObjectUI uses `{ id, label, filters[] }`. These were incompatible at the type level, requiring `as any` casts and offering no type safety for spec-format consumers.

### Types (`@object-ui/types`)
- Added `SpecQuickFilterItem`, `ObjectUIQuickFilterItem`, and `QuickFilterItem` union type
- `quickFilters` property on both `ObjectGridSchema` and `ListViewSchema` now accepts `QuickFilterItem[]`

### Normalize Utility (`@object-ui/core`)
- Extracted standalone `normalizeQuickFilter()` and `normalizeQuickFilters()` adapter functions into `packages/core/src/utils/normalize-quick-filter.ts`
- Full operator mapping: `eq`, `ne`, `neq`, `gt`, `gte`, `lt`, `lte`, `equals`, `contains`, etc.
- Properly typed with `QuickFilterItem` union input and `NormalizedQuickFilter` (alias of `ObjectUIQuickFilterItem`) output

### Bridge (`packages/react/src/spec-bridge/bridges/list-view.ts`)
- Bridge now normalizes quickFilters at spec→SchemaNode transform time using `normalizeQuickFilters()`
- Spec-format items are converted to ObjectUI format before reaching ListView

### ListView (`packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx`)
- Refactored to use shared `normalizeQuickFilters()` from `@object-ui/core` instead of inline normalization logic
- Extended `mapOperator` with spec shorthand operators for FilterBuilder usage

### Tests (162 total across 3 files)
- **12 unit tests** for `normalizeQuickFilter` utility: operator mapping, auto-generated labels, null values, icon/defaultActive preservation, unknown operator passthrough
- **6 bridge-level tests** in `P1SpecBridge.test.ts`: spec format normalization, ObjectUI passthrough, mixed arrays, auto-generated labels, null values, defaultActive/icon preservation
- **6 ListView integration tests**: spec format rendering, ObjectUI format rendering, mixed arrays, shorthand operators, auto-generated labels, null value edge case
- Removed all `as any` casts — union type covers both formats natively

```typescript
// Both formats now type-check without casts
const quickFilters: QuickFilterItem[] = [
  { id: 'active', label: 'Active', filters: [['status', '=', 'active']] },
  { field: 'priority', operator: 'eq', value: 'high', label: 'High Priority' },
];
```

> <issue_description>## 背景

> 
> ## 目标
> - 实现 QuickFilter 适配层，自动识别并转换两种格式
> - Spec format → ObjectUI format 自动转换
> - ObjectUI format 保持原生支持
> 
> ## 技术要点
> - Spec: `QuickFilterSchema { field: string, operator: string, value: any }`
> - ObjectUI: `QuickFilter { id: string, label: string, filters: any[], defaultActive?: boolean }`
> - 适配函数：`normalizeQuickFilter(input): ObjectUIQuickFilter`
> 
> ## 改动范围
> - `packages/types/src/objectql.ts` — 添加 Spec QuickFilter 类型 union
> - `packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` — quickFilters normalize 层
> - `packages/react/src/spec-bridge/bridges/list-view.ts` — bridge 映射
>

> - [ ] 混合格式数组可正常处理
> - [ ] 单元测试覆盖两种格式及边界场景
